official_package_dfols.allowed_claim: Evidence generated through the embedded official DFO-LS package bridge under the recorded package/runtime provenance.

historical_internal_dfols_style.allowed_claim: Historical or in-house DFO-LS-style evidence. It must not be described as official-package DFO-LS evidence.

reporting_rules: Public reports must say official_dfols only when the run records embedded official package provenance.
Historical in-house DFO-LS-style evidence may be retained as background or comparison evidence but must not certify the official package line.
M6 reference packages are historical/internal behavior anchors unless their provenance explicitly records official_dfols.
Production-comparison artifacts remain provisional until their commit, package, preset, method aliases, counters, and promotion boundary are recorded.
forbidden_claims: Do not call historical internal solver evidence official DFO-LS package evidence.
Do not use M6 historical/internal reference packages as official DFO-LS certification.
Do not omit package version and runtime path when making official package claims.
